journey.name: send scanner nearby states
journey.description:
The Send sheet's scanner names the sources it listens on and offers to turn on the missing ones, per the Figma "Send Bitcoin" scanner frames. Emulators have no NFC, so the NFC source and button never appear here; Bluetooth comes from the emulator's virtual controller. Reading a request over NFC or Bluetooth needs two devices and is a manual test in the PR.
Precondition: onboarded dev build wallet on an emulator with Bluetooth on, camera and Nearby devices permissions not yet granted (`adb shell pm revoke to.bitkit.dev android.permission.CAMERA`, and the same for BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap Send and choose "Don't allow" on the camera permission dialog

Verify the scanner area reads "Scan to pay" and "Allow Camera, Bluetooth, and NFC access to scan bitcoin invoices and pay more quickly.", with a camera button (testTag "ScannerEnableCamera") and a Bluetooth button (testTag "ScannerEnableBluetooth")
Run `adb shell pm grant to.bitkit.dev android.permission.CAMERA`, close the Send sheet and tap Send again
Verify the camera preview shows the Bluetooth button (testTag "ScannerEnableBluetooth") above a pill (testTag "ScannerStatus") reading "Scanning QR"
Tap the Bluetooth button and choose "Allow" on the Nearby devices permission dialog
Verify the Bluetooth button is gone and the pill reads "Scanning QR & Bluetooth"
